method: Saved node:test bodies executed using Node VM registration harness and bundled runtime

performanceObservation.fixture: 8-second mono 44.1 kHz sine, one +2-semitone control point; Node VM on this machine
performanceObservation.otherObservation: A 60-second mono local edit took about 2.2 seconds before the final cooperative-yield addition; no browser benchmark was performed.

limitations: Standard terminal launcher still fails with a Windows CET error; tests were run through a Node VM harness in the bundled runtime.
DOM, decodeAudioData and native media are simulated in controller tests.
Real WAV/MP3 browser decoding, physical dragging/layout, native event timing, external WAV playback, console errors and listening quality require manual checks.
Synthetic latency, frequency and discontinuity checks are not user or listening-study evidence.
No current runtime screenshots or participant test captured.
